summary: Agnar Beastamer will care for your egg until it hatches. Sprite darters eat meat and vegetation, and their young favor raw, juicy flanks. Agnar wants Silvermane stalker flanks for the hatchling.

sections.title: A Hatchling's First Meal
sections.body: Agnar Beastamer says sprite darters eat meat and vegetation. Their young favor raw, juicy flanks. Agnar will care for the egg until it hatches and wants Silvermane stalker flanks for the hatchling. Without a good first meal, the newborn might not live through its first week.

sections.title: Elune's Plan
sections.body: Agnar never learned why sprite darters eat meat. Agnar knows only that it is tied to Elune’s plan for the elves. Perhaps they were meant to be protectors, Agnar wonders, but cannot say for sure. Agnar also admits to being jealous that you got the egg.

sections.title: Back with the Flanks
sections.body: When you return with the flanks, Agnar judges them good enough. The egg looks just about ready to hatch. Agnar teases that you will soon be a mother or father, though you did not expect that kind of responsibility.

faq.q: What does a sprite darter eat?
faq.answer: Sprite darters eat meat and vegetation. Agnar Beastamer says raw, juicy flanks suit the young ones.

faq.q: Where is Agnar Beastamer caring for the egg?
faq.answer: Agnar cares for the egg in the Hinterlands, where the meat is brought.
Agnar wants five Silvermane stalker flanks for the hatchling.

faq.q: How does Elune connect to sprite darters?
faq.answer: Agnar never learned why darters eat meat, only that it is tied to Elune’s plan for the elves. Agnar wonders whether they were meant to be protectors.

faq.q: What happens if the hatchling has no good first meal?
faq.answer: Without a good first meal, the hatchling might not live through its first week, Agnar warns.
